blocks.content: Quiz: Why is it better to store isLoading and error in the Zustand store rather than inside a component?
Tap an option below to answer:
Because useState cannot hold boolean values
useState can hold any value including booleans. That is not why.
useState can hold any value including booleans. That is not why.
So any component in the app can read and react to the loading and error state without prop drilling
Correct! When isLoading and error live in the store, any component can read them directly. No need to pass them as props through the tree.
Correct! When isLoading and error live in the store, any component can read them directly. No need to pass them as props through the tree.
Because Zustand automatically handles fetch errors for you
Zustand does not handle errors automatically. You still need to use try/catch inside your async action.
Zustand does not handle errors automatically. You still need to use try/catch inside your async action.
Because components cannot access fetch responses directly
Components can absolutely fetch data themselves. The reason to move it to the store is about sharing state, not access.
Components can absolutely fetch data themselves. The reason to move it to the store is about sharing state, not access.
